loadError: Could not load the clinic settings. Please try again.
name: Clinic name
nameHelp: The name patients hear, for example: Sorriso Pleno.
assistantNameHelp: Optional. The name the assistant uses when it introduces itself, for example: Ana. Leave it empty for no name.
kindHelp: How the assistant describes the clinic to the model, in the clinic's language, for example: clínica odontológica.

assistantLanguage.label: Assistant language
assistantLanguage.help: The language the assistant uses with patients and in the brochure labels. It is not the panel language. Changing it does not translate the brochure text the clinic wrote: write that text in this same language.

assessment.label: General assessment
assessment.help: Shows it as an option in the service list

followUp.label: Follow-up visit
followUp.help: Adds Retorno/Follow-up as an option in the service list

serviceOptions.minutesLabel: Duration in minutes (empty uses the calendar default)

saved: Saved. The assistant uses the new settings from the next message.
saveError: Could not save the clinic settings. Please try again.

languageDialog.title: Change the assistant language?
languageDialog.body: From the next message the assistant will answer in {{language}}. The brochure text is not translated: if it is written in the other language, update it too.

publishOffer.published: Published. The assistant answers from the new text.
publishOffer.body: The brochure's automatic texts are now in {{language}}. Publish so the assistant's brochure uses them.

publishBar.published: Published. The assistant now answers from the new text.
publishBar.busy: Publishing is already running. Try again in a moment.
publishBar.unreachable: The assistant service is not reachable.
publishBar.failed: Could not publish. Please try again.

validation.minutesInvalid: Use a number from 15 to 240, in steps of 5, or leave it empty.
